summary_ja: DfDocument class methodはdocumentをw2/currentをw3のsigned32で扱う。document<10000ならdocument*10000の低32bitを選び、それ以外はdocumentを使う。
summary_en: The DfDocument class method uses signed32 document w2 and current w3. If document<10000, select the low32 bits of document*10000; otherwise use document unchanged.
limits_ja: 版番号のencoding・妥当性・負数の意味は未確定。multiplyは32bit wrapであり入力検査ではない。
limits_en: Version encoding, validity and negative-input meaning are unknown. Multiplication wraps32 bits; this is not input validation.

summary_ja: normalized<=currentなら0。normalized>currentならsigned32(current+5000)以上を先に判定して1、次にsigned32(current+1000)以上で2、それ以外0。current=55000ではnormalized55001..55999も0、56000..59999は2、60000以上は1。
summary_en: Return0 when normalized<=current. Otherwise test signed32(current+5000) first for1, then signed32(current+1000) for2, else0. At current55000, normalized55001..55999 also return0,56000..59999 return2, and60000 or above return1.
limits_ja: threshold加算も32bit wrap。0/1/2のenum意味は未読で、0を新しい版の拒否や受理と呼べない。
limits_en: Threshold additions also wrap32 bits. Return0/1/2 enum meanings are unknown;0 cannot be labeled acceptance or rejection of newer versions.
